findings.title: Terminal observation bits lack the physical position values required by the existing diagnostics

evidence.missing: No224-byte field carries100 or103/3, and no parent before/after stat/immutability procedure is specified. Repurposing written would erase the confirmed-write distinction.

findings.required_fix: Add four explicit u64 stdout/stderr start/end positions with separate observation flags, derive the new exact256-byte length, and define unavailable values plus ordered/end>=start checks. Keep confirmed written counters separate. Alternatively retain224 only with a complete reviewed parent before/after position/immutability protocol that really reconstructs all original start/physical-prefix values; the current docs do not specify one.
findings.scope: This is an encoding/diagnostic correspondence gap, not a request to manufacture physical progress on write failure.

findings.title: Define exact terminal reason/validity/status/projection rules instead of deferring them

deadline_counterexample.case_A: Elapsed1800s body deadline reached before7200 polls: timed_out=true,poll_limited=false.
deadline_counterexample.case_B: After the7200th250ms sleep, next poll admission refuses before elapsed check: timed_out=false,poll_limited=true.
deadline_counterexample.gap: No independent timed_out/poll_limited flags or semantic reason code. A generic site7 cannot project both existing booleans.

evidence.raw_exit_counterexample: targetRawExit=0x80000000 is a valid ordinary nonzero32-bit process exit and corresponds to parent int32 -2147483648, not a checked positive int conversion.
other_unresolved_cases: Shared raw-log cap versus complete-stage-pool cap versus non-cap stage guard; original log_cap/omitted booleans and witnesses differ.

A worker gets100 bytes in completed inner reads then errors before publishing a full/EOF-short chunk: define observed/omitted/unretained and parent projection; a generic settled-read phrase is insufficient.
First secondary failure may be semantic, followed by a native cleanup error: define count, first native error/site and existing primary/first-secondary ownership.
Position observations are not byte-counter validity. Define which prefix counters remain exact when a worker is still live, without unsynchronized reads or numeric-zero success.

findings.required_fix: Provide a normative flag/status/site/reason table and cross-field admission matrix, including independent timeout/poll-limit/log-cap distinctions, status0/1 versus refusal/quarantine prerequisites, signed raw-exit bit reinterpretation, counter snapshots/overflow, EOF/settlement relationships and all parent child-row/cleanup/primary-secondary projections. Add needed flags/reason fields explicitly and recompute length if fields change. Do not infer reasons from metered usage or generic site7.

findings.title: Complete the request launch/identity/environment contract before architecture acceptance

evidence.path_grammar: The plan expressly defers executable quoting, prefix and hex/NUL/EOF grammar; at most512 units is ambiguous between decoded path cells and the encoded token.
evidence.run_identity: Canonical run-identity SHA has no defined domain tag, source fields, normalization/case/slash rules or byte serialization. Copying a label is not computing the expected current identity.
evidence.environment: The eight target values/order are named, but the supervisor launch environment and target native environment-block construction/order/NUL rules are not specified. No environment inheritance must cover both processes.
evidence.string_profile: Original target arguments and environment values use ASCII32..126 with length<=512; other paths use their corresponding valid-UTF16/length/filesystem guards. Applying one blanket stricter guard or treating embedded NUL/unknown roots as C strings is not correspondence.

findings.required_fix: Specify one exact bounded raw command-line grammar (including executable token, fixed argument prefix, decoded<=512 UTF16 cells/encoded extent, uppercase/lowercase hex decision, quoting, surrogate/NUL and no-extra-argument rules). Define canonical run-identity input bytes and exact expected childIndex/argc/envcount/identity binding. Define both helper and target explicit environment recipes, sorted/native block layout and full source-field string guards while preserving existing28/6 and eight-value target domain. Add a bounded request parser/check sequence before any length-based access/allocation or target creation.

findings.title: Define the source-counter observation cutoff and prepaid cleanup/publication tail
findings.evidence: The terminal contains supervisorSourceUsed, yet encoding/writing/flushing/publishing the terminal and final cleanup themselves execute source operations after a snapshot. Source-counter observed alone does not say whether it is a prefix debit or complete usage. Budget exhaustion/failure must still pay for bounded cancellation, owner settlement attempts and an honest terminal/unknown record; no partition/cutoff/overflow rule is defined.
findings.required_fix: Define the same-origin caller slice, predecode/unknown-usage ownership, body versus mandatory bounded cleanup/publication reservation, exact debit/observation cutoff and checked overflow behavior. Label/report a prefix observation honestly or establish the accepted precharge/tail accounting rule; do not silently count future work as already observed or reset the runner budget. Parent composition must retain the full reservation whenever complete usage is unavailable.

findings.title: Separate architecture/source-authoring review from complete source/native/resource execution proof
findings.evidence: ADR146–148 requires complete source-work sponsorship and native/profile premises before implementation; the plan then authors the source, obtains a whole source census and later uses compile-only qualification for binary/ABI association. Read literally, final source/native facts are prerequisites for producing the source/object needed to establish them. The plan also requires every protocol ambiguity resolved before accepting ADR, so these missing exact contracts cannot simply be left to code.
findings.required_fix: State the ordered gates explicitly: accepted exact architecture/protocol/owner/funding strategy -> authorized source-only candidate -> whole functional/census/resource proposal with all premises recorded -> separately reviewed bounded compile-only purpose qualification where needed -> complete actual source/native/resource/binding acceptance before any helper/fixture/Clock execution. Keep every execution gate closed until its own proof, without demanding nonexistent final-source/ABI facts merely to author an unrun candidate.

recommendation: Revise the complete proposed docs with exact protocol/projections and noncircular gates, preserve R1, then obtain fresh whole critic review. Source implementation remains unauthorized.
